question: A machine working on a Carnot cycle operates between 305 K and 260 K. What will be the COP when it is operated as a refrigerating machine?
solution:
The correct answer is __5.78__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• COP (Coefficient of Performance)__ is a measure of the efficiency of a refrigerating machine.
 
• It is defined as the ratio of the heat removed from the refrigerated space to the work input.
 
• For a Carnot cycle operating as a refrigeration machine, COP is given by:

 COP = Tₗₒw / (Tₕᵢgₕ - Tₗₒw), where Tₗₒw and Tₕᵢgₕ are the lower and higher absolute temperatures respectively.
 
• Substituting the values:

 Tₗₒw = 260 K, Tₕᵢgₕ = 305 K:

 COP = 260 / (305 - 260) = 5.78.
 
• The higher the COP, the more efficient the refrigerating machine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Factors Affecting COP:**

 
 
• The temperature difference between the heat source and the heat sink affects the COP significantly.
 
• Higher temperature differences reduce the COP of the refrigeration system.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Refrigeration:**
 
 
• Food preservation to prevent spoilage.
 
• Industrial applications such as chemical manufacturing and process cooling.
 
• Air conditioning for maintaining comfortable indoor environments.
